<RecipePage recipeId="import-skill-from-github">

<RecipeSection label="Problem">

Some teams keep Agent Skills in GitHub rather than a local SKILL.md. Previewing that URL, importing only the selected skills, and syncing a captured ID is a different job from the first persist or name-based versioning. This recipe uses a public GitHub skill directory at a commit SHA so the run is answerable on the reader's tenant without a seeded corpus.

</RecipeSection>

<RecipeCodeWalkthrough />

<RecipeArchitecture />

<RecipePrereqs />

<RecipeSteps />

<RecipeSection label="Preview before import">

Inspect the GitHub URL with previewSource first. Preview persists neither a source nor any skill.

</RecipeSection>

<RecipeSection label="Import selected URLs only">

Pass source URLs returned by preview. Import is atomic: if any selected URL cannot be fetched, validated, or persisted, no skills are created.

</RecipeSection>

<RecipeSection label="Fail when GitHub is unreachable">

If this tenant cannot fetch GitHub, stop. Do not skip verification or treat an empty preview as success.

</RecipeSection>

<RecipeSection label="Delete by captured ID only">

Cleanup deletes only IDs this run created. Never choose a cleanup target by display name or a broad catalog search. If delete fails, do not report cleanup completed.

</RecipeSection>

<RecipeSection label="Experimental API">

The scaffold opts in with includeExperimental, but the Skills endpoints may still be unavailable on a tenant or change before general availability.

</RecipeSection>

<RecipeSection label="GitHub must be fetchable">

Preview, import, and sync require the Glean tenant to fetch the public GitHub fixture. A blocked or unconfigured GitHub fetch is a failed verify, not a skipped one.

</RecipeSection>

<RecipeSection label="OAuth policy varies by tenant">

Native Skills scopes may not yet be grantable everywhere. The login wrapper uses the legacy compatibility scope only for a recognized scope-grant failure; a user-scoped token remains an explicit fallback.

</RecipeSection>

<TakeItFurther>

- Pass --source-url to preview a different public GitHub skill directory after the default commit-SHA source succeeds.
- Use the Intermediate publishing recipe when the source of truth is a local bundle and you need version supersession or zip sandboxing.
- Call glean.skills.createVersion() or PATCH enable/disable only after you already have a captured skill ID.

</TakeItFurther>
